scope.note: Not listed separately in plan section 1.3: action rows are children of the reserved content_rule ids, so they share that range.

gaps.summary: Players never die, so boss and bomb deaths, the hospital sequence and the "Not yourself!" message are absent.
evidence: footage A4-35..A4-39 (death and hospital inside the boot camp)

gaps.summary: Kill experience and loot use the emulator formula instead of the observed payouts and their modifiers.
evidence: footage kill payouts in A4, C1 and C2 (observed 71 XP / 10 credits)

gaps.summary: Context 1985 runs as one shared world: Youngblood, the boss and the reinforcements are shared and their arrival events are not reproduced.
gaps.condition: Open only before S3 lands, or after a fallback to a shared 1985 channel (build plan section 2.5).
surfaced_by: startup warning when a second client enters a context flagged for instancing but running shared

gaps.summary: McAllister does not walk off with the recruit, and Youngblood does not walk into the camp on arrival.
evidence: footage A3-011 (McAllister walks away with the recruit, 297.133)
no NPC path movement mechanism exists (build plan section 1.3)
gaps.closes_with: evidence for a path movement mechanism

gaps.summary: Character creation items do not match the observed empty 0/50 backpack and pistol 122875; creation armour duplicates the crate gear.
Tutorial tips 10000011, 7 and 6/10000010 have no server binding.
evidence: footage A2-042 (tip 10000011: proximity or completeable binding unresolved)

gaps.summary: Emulator teleporter row 60 stays usable in the shared 1985 world.
evidence: emulator teleporter rows 60, 99 and 598 in context 1985 (read-only rasaworld.db)
gaps.closes_with: S3 (teleporter rows are not materialized in instances)

gaps.summary: The cave-in blocker and its indicator 439 are unknown.
evidence: objective indicator 439 "Cave-in Location" (docs/evidence/bootcamp-client-catalog.json, store offset 3908); no blocker or position is identified (build plan S4 stubs)

gaps.summary: Mission item rewards are not delivered, including the hinted 1994 AccuMax Shotgun.
gaps.closes_with: item grant planner wired into turn-in, plus evidence for the reward items

gaps.summary: No bomb inventory item exists; planting is gated by objective state instead.
evidence: no bomb item template identified in the client item tables yet (build plan section 4.1 step E4)

gaps.summary: The stuck state after abandoning the final mission once the dropship pad is cleared is kept as an original quirk.
evidence: D13.4 known issue, wiki/verify/web/d134-20090203215404.txt: abandoning after clearing the dropship pad strands the recruit; failing the mission normally respawns the ship

gaps.summary: The 1995 turn-in NPC Rogers is absent in context 1220; he is level 5 where footage shows 20.
surfaced_by: DefinitionGaps unaffected (the receiver exists as a row)

gaps.summary: The Training Day forced radio offer on arrival in Alia Das and missions 2010/2011 are not provided.
evidence: footage B2-023 (Training Day forced offer on arrival)

gaps.summary: Skipping the boot camp grants nothing; the pre-D11 bypass rewards are obsolete and are not used.
evidence: no final-live evidence of skip rewards (build plan S7)

gaps.summary: NPC classes and appearance are analogues, and NPC hues are random.
evidence: footage A2-040, A3-028, A5-33, B2-012 (NPC appearance)

gaps.summary: Every account is GM level 1 and can use .tele or .givelogos to bypass content.
The "You just gained Alia Das Hospital." message on arrival is not produced.
evidence: depends on the hospital system of track D (build plan S6 stubs)

gaps.summary: A delay before the first radio offer is added only if the S1 owner check shows the offer dropped right after MapLoaded.
gaps.condition: Conditional: opened only by the S1 owner check.
evidence: footage A2-007 -> A2-013 (offer window 0.73 s after the first world frame)

non_content_settings.note: Operational rollout and rollback gate for the rebuilt boot camp. It is not gameplay and not a reconstructed original value: it only decides which new characters start in context 1985 (build plan section 1.2 entry gate, invariant I8, OD-1). When it does not admit a character, creation keeps the existing context 1220 start.
